Your models. Your choice.

Use your ChatGPT account, or connect your own AI services. A familiar client, with room to do more.

ChatGPT Web
Sign in with your existing account. No API key needed.
AIChat
Connect supported providers or add your own service.
A familiar composer
Reference with @, attach files, and send with Enter. Shift-Enter starts a new line.

Bring the context. Keep your place.

Recent Telegram messages. A page in Safari. An error in Terminal. Bring the text into your conversation, preview it, and choose what to share.

Connected app context is read-only. Review it before sending.

A browser you can see.

Ask AIChat to compare a few product pages. It can open tabs, read pages, follow links, fill forms, and take screenshots in the same browser you see.

Browser tools require an AIChat model that supports tool calls. You can also use the browser on its own.

From a question to a task.

With a tool-capable model, AIChat can search, read, and write files in its working directory, create interactive content, and organize context as a conversation grows.
